notablePrerequisites:
Phantasmal Image is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Phantasmal Image do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Phantasmal Image.
Activate Phantasmal Image by tapping it.
When Phantasmal Image becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Phantasmal Image's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
